newsitem.title: USA: Showscan says Pope to succeed Soady as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Showscan says Pope to succeed Soady as CEO.

text.p: Showscan Entertainment Inc said Wednesday its President and Chief Executive Officer William Soady has tendered his resignation, effective at the end of the month.
Dennis Pope, chief financial officer, will succeed Soady as president and chief executive officer.

"It is with great reluctance that we accepted Bill Soady's resignation, as he has been responsible for developing and implementing the strategy that effected the foundation for Showscan's turnaround," said Chairman William Eberle.
"Soady's management team brought the company to nominal profitability and have maintained it at break-even through extremely difficult times in this industry," he added.
Soady will remain on the company's board of directors.
Showscan specializes in the production and exhibition of movie-based entertainment attractions shown in giant screen and large-screen, special-format theatres worldwide.
